pattern: Single-segment year field in a labelled group with a button that opens a non-modal dialog popup (WAI-ARIA APG date picker dialog pattern, non-modal variant) containing a paged role=grid of years with a roving tabindex.

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown
"Choose year", or "Change year, {value}" (for example "Change year, 2026") when a value is set
polite (announces the decade, for example "2020 - 2029", when the page changes)
"true" when the page reaches min/max or year 1/9999 (focus stays on the button)
Formatted year, for example "2026" (absent on the empty year-0 slot)
"true" on the selected year only (absent otherwise)
"date" on the current year (configured timezone or today option)
"true" for years outside min/max or rejected by isYearDisabled

keyboard.action: Enters up to four digits; fewer than four digits is incomplete (year 5 is typed 0005). Non-digits are removed.
Increments or decrements the year, stopping at 1 and 9999; an empty segment starts at the current year.
Opens the popup without changing the segment.
Moves from the segment to the button.
Opens the popup (or closes it when open); focus moves to the selected year, else the current year, clamped to min/max.
Next / previous year (mirrored in RTL), crossing into the adjacent decade.
Plus / minus 5 years (next / previous row), crossing into the adjacent decade.
First / last year of the row.

Picks the year unless it is disabled; with closeOnSelect (default) the popup closes and focus returns to the button, otherwise focus stays on the cell. Emits aui-change if the value or validity changed.
Shows the previous / next decade; no-op while aria-disabled.
Closes the popup without changing the value; focus inside the popup returns to the button. Only the topmost overlay responds, so a surrounding Dialog stays open.
Moves between the previous and next buttons and the focused year; focus leaving the popup (other than to the choose button) closes it.

focus: The segment and the button are tab stops. Opening moves focus to one year cell (roving tabindex: exactly one cell has tabindex=0; the empty year-0 slot is never focusable). Movement is clamped to min/max and years 1-9999; disabled years stay focusable. Picking with closeOnSelect, Escape, and closing through the button return focus to the button; focus is moved before the popup hides, so it never falls to the document body. A pointer press outside the popup and the button closes it. Moving focus between the segment, button, and popup does not mark the field touched.
notes: The label is a <label> associated through aria-labelledby because a group is not labelable; clicking the label focuses the segment.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; the segment carries the native required state.
The segment remains the primary input; the grid is an alternative, and a typed year rejected by isYearDisabled gets a localized message so both paths agree.
The popup is non-modal: focus is not trapped and the rest of the page stays reachable.
Errors appear after focus leaves the whole control by default.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior (dialog announcement, page changes, cell states) has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
